Curve delineation package.what: Chevron signs on every canyon curve, plus sequential flashing chevrons on the 10 worst curves, so drivers see how sharp each bend is in time to slow down. The 60% reduction counts only at those 10 curves; 16% elsewhere.
Curve delineation package.targets: Fixed-object and rollover crashes on canyon curves
sources: FHWA: Enhanced delineation for horizontal curves

Center line rumble strips.what: Grooves milled into the center line that rumble when a driver drifts toward oncoming traffic.
Center line rumble strips.targets: Head-on and opposite-direction sideswipe crashes, MP 65–88 (same-direction sideswipes left out)
sources: FHWA: Longitudinal rumble strips on two-lane roads

Wider edge lines.what: 6-inch edge lines instead of 4-inch, painted at the next restriping, so the road edge is easier to see at night and in bad weather.
Wider edge lines.targets: Run-off-road, head-on and opposite-direction sideswipe crashes away from intersections, MP 65–88

High-friction surface on worst curves.what: A bonded high-friction aggregate overlay on the worst curves, giving tires more grip when drivers brake or steer hard.
High-friction surface on worst curves.targets: Crashes on the curves with the most excess crashes after Empirical Bayes screening

Shoulder rumble strips where shoulders a.what: Rumble strips on the shoulder that alert drivers drifting off the road, only where the shoulder is wide enough: MP 75.5–88 where CDOT records 4 ft or more. Street View shows 1–3 ft against rock through MP 65–75.5, so that stretch is left out.
Shoulder rumble strips where shoulders a.targets: Fixed-object and rollover crashes where the shoulder is 4 ft or wider, MP 75.5–88
sources: FHWA: Longitudinal rumble strips on two-lane roads

Intersection redesign (roundabout or RCU.what: Rebuild Loveland's two unsignalized intersections with the most angle and turning crashes as a roundabout or a restricted-crossing U-turn. Most of Loveland's angle crashes, and half its severe ones, are at signals, which this does not treat.
Intersection redesign (roundabout or RCU.targets: Angle and turning crashes at the 2 busiest unsignalized intersections

SafetyEdge at next repaving.what: A 30° sloped pavement edge, shaped during repaving, so a tire that drops off the edge can climb back on without the driver over-steering.
SafetyEdge at next repaving.targets: Run-off-road, head-on and opposite-direction sideswipe crashes, MP 65–88

Lighting gaps.what: Light the Loveland intersections that are dark now. Officers recorded most night crashes at Loveland intersections as already lighted, so only the unlit ones count.
Lighting gaps.targets: Night crashes at unlit Loveland intersections

Signal backplates.what: Black backplates with a reflective yellow border on the signal heads, so signals stand out against the sky and stay visible in a power outage.
Signal backplates.targets: Angle and turning crashes at Loveland signals
